{
  "name": "@animegarden/monorepo",
  "version": "0.5.5",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "turbo run build",
    "build:cli": "turbo run build --filter @animegarden/cli...",
    "build:server": "turbo run build --filter @animegarden/server...",
    "build:web": "turbo run build --filter @animegarden/web...",
    "build:worker": "turbo run build --filter @animegarden/worker...",
    "dev": "turbo run dev --parallel",
    "dev:cron": "tsx apps/server/src/cli.ts cron",
    "dev:server": "tsx apps/server/src/cli.ts start --port=8080",
    "dev:web": "pnpm -C apps/web dev",
    "dev:worker": "pnpm -C apps/worker dev",
    "format": "turbo run format --parallel",
    "manager": "tsx apps/server/src/cli.ts",
    "plugins:check": "node scripts/package-plugins.ts --check",
    "plugins:pack": "node scripts/package-plugins.ts --archive",
    "plugins:sync": "node scripts/package-plugins.ts",
    "prepare": "husky",
    "release": "bumpp package.json packages/*/package.json apps/*/package.json --commit --push --tag",
    "start:cron": "node apps/server/cli.mjs cron",
    "start:server": "node apps/server/cli.mjs start",
    "start:web": "node apps/web/server.mjs",
    "test:ci": "turbo run test:ci",
    "typecheck": "turbo run typecheck",
    "preversion": "turbo run test:ci"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@cloudflare/workers-types": "5.20261101.1",
    "@flydotio/dockerfile": "0.7.12",
    "@total-typescript/ts-reset": "0.6.1",
    "@types/better-sqlite3": "9.6.0",
    "@types/fs-extra": "11.0.4",
    "@types/node": "26.6.6",
    "@vite-pwa/assets-generator": "2.0.0",
    "bumpp": "latest",
    "cf": "1.0.0-beta.26",
    "drizzle-kit": "0.31.11",
    "husky": "9.1.7",
    "prettier": "3.9.10",
    "tsx": "4.23.15",
    "turbo": "2.11.10",
    "typescript": "6.0.3",
    "unbuild": "3.6.1",
    "vite": "8.3.5",
    "vitest": "5.0.5",
    "wrangler": "4.156.0"
  },
  "packageManager": "pnpm@12.16.1",
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=v24.0.0"
  }
}
